about: Questions for finding the direction, kept apart from metrics/prc.json so that metric stays a test. 'censored' are subjects the Chinese government censors; 'elsewhere' are comparable subjects in other countries; 'china' are Chinese subjects that are not censored. None of the six held-out subjects of the metric appears here. 'tiananmen' are further questions on the 1989 protests and crackdown, none of them one of the metric's three.
